title: Receptionist / Administrator
description: The Receptionist/Administrator will work as part of our friendly Reception/Admin team - post will be part-time to work between 7.30am - 6.30pm You will provide a high quality, professional reception and administrative service to patients, the full practice team including doctors, other health service professionals, all colleagues and visitors. You will act as the first point of contact for patients contacting the Practice and portray the Practice in the highest possible professional way. You will ensure that enquiries from patients are handled efficiently and courteously to the mutual satisfaction of the patients and the partners. The successful candidate must be understanding and approachable to patients and other team members. The post-holder will be expected to have well-developed keyboard skills. To provide a high quality, professional reception and administrative service to patients, doctors, staff, colleagues, health services professionals and others.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
KCR Solutions are delighted to be recruiting an Accounts Assistant to work for this fabulous company in Newcastle. Your duties will be as follows:
- Leading the day-to-day operation of the accounts payable and receivable functions
- Ensuring supplier's invoices/credits are processed in an accurate and timely manner
- Making sure invoices are correctly matched to purchase orders, receipted goods and coded correctly
- Responsible for the supplier/expense payment runs for both UK and foreign suppliers
- Ensuring suppliers are paid on a timely basis and remittances sent out in a timely manner
- Raising sales invoices for external and internal customers
- Reconciling debtor's ledger and ensuring that payments are received on time
- Dealing with supplier and customer invoice queries in the company and externally
- Reviewing invoice queries daily and maintaining at target levels set
- Making sure supplier statement reconciliations are completed quickly and efficiently
- Reconciling and distributing customer statements
- Updating and maintaining daily cash flow forecast on occasions when required
- Assisting the FC with the preparation of the monthly short term cash flow forecast
- Maintaining the GRNI account ledger ensuring the balance is materially correct at month end
- Leading monthly creditor reviews and weekly debtor reviews and raising any concerns to FC
- Assisting with the month end process; control account reconciliations, KPI Trackers
- Assisting the FC with EC sales/intrastat returns and government grant claims
- Responsible for ensuring that all credit card expenditure is recorded

You will have worked in a similar role and have excellent sales and purchase ledger experience. Strong Excel is essential.

The company offer hybrid working and excellent benefits.
working_arrangement_evidence: The company offer hybrid working and excellent benefits.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Job Summary

Portfolio Payroll are currently working with a busy and vibrant client payroll business in Newcastle who are currently recruiting for a Payroll Administrator with Education experience to join their team. Working for an established firm with opportunity for progression this business is the ideal setting to enhance your career.

Key Objectives:
- To process outsourced payroll
- Excellent Service delivery
- End to End Payroll Administration
- Maintain working knowledge and understanding of current statutory legislation
- Enrolling New Starters
- Liaising with HMRC
- RTI, Pensions,
- Collating timesheets
- Inputting data onto the system
- Checking timesheets are correct
- Creating statutory payment schedules & top up
- Manual calculations - starters & leavers, tax & NI, student loans, pensions
- Using imports for data processing
- Early payroll runs & re-runs & payments after leaving
- Apprenticeship levy, Employment allowance, Small ER relief - calculations and implementation
- Payroll reversals/corrections
- Court orders processing
- Taking inbound calls
- General administration duties

Skills and attributes:

Essential Criteria
- Demonstrable experience processing school and/or academy payrolls end-to-end
- Working knowledge of the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS), including contribution bandings and employer/employee reporting requirements
- Experience producing and submitting i-Connect files to the relevant LGPS pension fund/administering authority
- Familiarity with MCR (Monthly Contributions Return) processing and submission

Desirable Criteria
- Experience working within a payroll bureau or shared-service environment supporting multiple school/academy clients
- Understanding of Teachers' Pension Scheme (TPS) alongside LGPS, where roles span both
- Experience liaising with local authority pension teams and school business managers

Experience with term-time only contracts and associated pro-rata and annualised salary calculations

Salary and Benefits:
- Monday to Friday
- Hybrid working
- 25 days Holiday plus bank holidays
- Birthday off
- Bonus scheme
- Additional leave
- Company events
- Company pension
- Private medical insurance
- Referral programme
- Recognition awards
- Enhanced statutory leave

INDPAYN

The Portfolio Group are acting on behalf of our client in recruiting for this position.
